source_name: Wikipedie – Bankovní identita (cs) as a glossary/actor-map bootstrap
why_relevant: Low-credibility but high-yield pointer: consolidates the member-bank list, official entity name (Bankovní identita, a.s.) and terminology variants (Bank iD / BankID / bankovní identita) used to expand search coverage. Every fact must be re-verified against primary sources.

Czech ICT/online-business daily that reports bank platform launches, vendor selections, BankID, cloud migrations and digital-channel rebuilds with named suppliers; tag pages act as ready-made topic feeds for banks, fintech, akvizice, BankID.

Consumer-finance daily that dissects new payment services, card/FX propositions and bank T&C changes in operational detail (feature-by-feature), useful for detecting product launches that imply a new processing/technology partner.

source_name: Peníze.cz — osobní účty / běžné účty a tiskové zprávy
why_relevant: Carries both editorial interviews with bank digital/IT executives (e.g. core-banking replacement programmes) and a hosted press-release section that republishes vendor and bank announcements verbatim — a two-in-one signal channel.

Leading Czech startup/tech outlet; covers bank–fintech investments, corporate venture arms (KB Smart Solutions), fintech launches and vendor tie-ups, often with founder/executive quotes not in official releases.

Business daily with a dedicated banking desk and long-form interviews ('traditional banks are quietly becoming fintechs') that surface strategy, transformation programmes and supplier decisions at CZ banks.

Highest-credibility Czech business daily; investigative coverage of large IT tenders and vendor switches (e.g. tax administration replacing a 30-year incumbent) — the model of reporting that also exposes bank supplier changes and contract values. Archive subdomain preserves older pieces.

Czech enterprise-IT monthly with unusually specific articles on core banking system replacement, IT governance in banks and vendor architectures — exactly the vendor-switch detail that consumer media omit.
Dedicated case-study stream where Czech integrators describe implementations at named customers (incl. banks) — direct vendor-to-customer mapping evidence for workstream A6.

source_name: CIOtrends / CIO Business World — soutěž Případová studie
why_relevant: Annual competition in which Czech ICT suppliers submit their reference projects with customer names; multi-year archive is effectively a longitudinal register of who implemented what for whom, including financial-sector clients.

source_name: ČTK Infobanka (ib.ctk.cz) — national news agency archive
why_relevant: Authoritative Czech news-agency archive; the canonical record of agency reporting on bank deals, contract awards and executive changes, including items that only ever ran on the wire. Deep back-archive is the strongest historical layer available in cs.

source_name: CIA News — cianews.cz finance/banking daily digest
why_relevant: Long-running (21+ years) Czech business-intelligence digest with a dedicated finance edition covering banking, insurance, capital markets and payment technologies — a curated pointer layer that surfaces items scattered across many outlets.

Investment/finance portal of the Roklen group with a standing fintech category and 'quick news' items announcing partnerships between fintechs, hubs and financial institutions — a fast weak-signal channel.

Niche Czech fintech platform publishing executive interviews (e.g. data leadership at Komerční banka) and event coverage; smaller reach but often gets practitioner detail on internal platforms and vendors.

source_name: Forbes.cz — byznys/tech coverage of bank IT
why_relevant: Publishes access-journalism features on bank IT investment (billions into technology, team structures) and on major vendor replacements in Czech public IT — useful for budget-scale and decision-maker mapping.
Business weekly/portal that frames competitive moves explicitly (e.g. a bank launching an ECB-rate FX service as a challenge to Revolut) — good for competitor-positioning signals in cs.
High-volume Czech personal-finance news stream covering bank product and fee changes; useful as broad-coverage baseline to catch launches that other outlets miss.
Short-form Czech IT-business newsfeed that reliably reports tenders, contract awards and vendor announcements ('vypsala tendr na nový informační systém'), including financial-sector IT.

source_name: Kurzy.cz — news aggregator (author-indexed feeds incl. Roklen24)
why_relevant: Aggregates Czech financial news from many publishers into author/source-indexed feeds, providing a single crawl point to discover items across outlets and to recover articles later removed from origin sites.

source_name: Právě dnes (pravednes.cz) — source-indexed Czech news mirror
why_relevant: Mirrors headline streams per source, including Časopis Bankovnictví and general economics — a cheap, open pointer to trade-magazine output whose own site is partly gated.
Seznam's syndication surface republishes Bankovnictví articles; provides an alternate, index-friendly access path to trade-magazine content and a way to date-stamp items.

source_name: SEND.cz / Periodik.cz — Bankovnictví magazine back-issue archive
why_relevant: Subscription vendors expose per-year issue listings and tables of contents for Časopis Bankovnictví, allowing historical topic/vendor mapping and targeted purchase of specific back issues without a full archive licence.

source_name: FinTech Futures / Banking Technology — Czech bank vendor selections (EN cross-check)
why_relevant: English trade press names the vendor and the deal scope for CZ bank selections (e.g. ČSOB choosing nCino for commercial lending); serves as the corroboration layer for Czech-language reporting and catches vendor-side announcements that CZ media skip.

source_name: The Fintech Times — Czech fintech landscape features (EN)
why_relevant: Periodic country landscape write-ups that name active CZ players, regulators and recent deals — a fast orientation and actor-map refresher for the cell, to be verified against cs primary reporting.

Primary English-language landing point for banking/payments vendor win announcements; carries both editorial coverage and a vendor press-release wire ('pressarticle') where CZ/CEE deals (e.g. Global Payments/CaixaBank/Erste JV, iDenfy-Bank iD) surface. Free-text search plus tag pages allow standing monitoring for Czech bank names and vendor names.

Netherlands-based independent payments news service with recurring CZ coverage: LEVERIS selected by Ceska sporitelna for IT transformation, Banking Circle joining the Czech Fintech Association, FSS/Fair Play acquiring entry to CZ, Revolut CEE launches. Strong on PSP/acquiring and vendor-selection items that Czech media report only vaguely.

source_name: IBS Intelligence — Czech Republic tag archive
source_subtype: analyst-adjacent trade press with country archive
why_relevant: Core-banking/vendor-deal specialist publication with a dedicated Czech Republic tag page — a ready-made pointer to every CZ item they have run (e.g. ING Bank picks FICO for risk management in Czech Republic; ING retail exit). Highest signal-to-noise per page in this cell for supplier selections.

source_name: IBSi Sales League Table (core banking / digital banking deal database)
why_relevant: The only widely-cited annual AGGREGATION of banking-software deal counts by vendor and region; the aggregate view of who is winning CEE/Czech core banking and payments deals exists nowhere in Czech-language sources. Even the free summary/press coverage gives vendor rankings usable as a competitive baseline.
